statement.p: Let V be the vector space of symmetric 2\times 2 matrices and W be the subspace W=\text{span} \lbrace \left[\begin{array}{cc} -5 \amp 5\cr 5 \amp 2 \end{array}\right],\left[\begin{array}{cc} 5 \amp -3\cr -3 \amp -3 \end{array}\right] \rbrace .
a. Find a nonzero element X in W.
b. Find an element Y in V that is not in W.
